scope: Dated, partial official-source snapshots plus explicitly labelled local recommendations; not submission certification.
null_semantics: Not specified or not verified. Never interpret null as no requirement.

general.label: General stellar-science working figure
notes: All values in this general profile are local working choices, not a journal specification.
Vector-first plots, redundant colour/marker/line encodings, explicit uncertainty and units are recommended.
Custom physical widths are allowed. Inspect the final manuscript at actual size.

aas.label: AAS journals: ApJ, AJ, ApJS and related titles
notes: The graphics page does not supply the single/double column widths used here; recommended_width_mm is a local starting point.
Choose common fonts and retain distinguishable line styles or markers when colours are used.
An interactive or animated figure also needs a numbered static representation.
AASTeX 7 prefers deluxetable; long tables need the appropriate long-table markup and machine-readable data.

aa.label: Astronomy & Astrophysics
verification_limits: The official PDF's indexed text was inspected; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403. The complete current document and submission portal must be checked before submission.
notes: The indexed official guide gives 88 mm one-column and at most 180 mm full-width figures, with an intermediate 120 mm option.
Use legible lettering after reduction; no numerical minimum type size, line weight or raster DPI was verified for this snapshot.
The 8 pt serif setting is a local recommendation, not an A&A numerical rule.
Avoid background grids or colours unless they convey scientific information. Keep panel labels inside the image.

mnras.label: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
notes: The artwork section cites 84 mm single-column figures and approximately 8 pt lettering; 8 pt is guidance, not a stated strict minimum.

The TIFF subsection specifies 300 ppi halftone and 800 ppi combination artwork; a separate paragraph says bitmap elements should be at least 400 dpi. Treat image-type-specific requirements explicitly.
Quantitative plots need borders and ticks on all four sides. Embed common fonts and prefer vector line plots.
Tables use three horizontal rules, without vertical rules or coloured cells; long online tables need machine-readable data with column descriptions.

nature-astronomy.label: Nature Astronomy
verification_limits: The official journal-specific page's indexed full text was inspected; direct retrieval redirected to a blocked identity-provider endpoint. Accepted artwork formats and all article-type-specific requirements require a live recheck.
notes: The journal-specific AIP page gives maximum width 180 mm, standard sans-serif lettering 5–7 pt and image panels at least 300 dpi.
The page does not define single/double column widths; recommended_width_mm is local. Nature main-journal 89/183 mm values are not imported.
Keep labels and scale/error bars editable; explain uncertainty in captions. Tables belong at the end of the text document; complex data may be separate Excel files.
An empty supported_formats list means acceptance was not verified, not that no format is accepted. Distinguish initial, final, Extended Data and supplementary requirements.
